The '''Armath system''' was located in the [[Mikaster sector/Legends|Mikaster sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Armath]], where [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Zell]] of the planet [[Majoor]] went on a [[Peace mission to Armath|peace mission]]<ref name="d3" /> in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{DroidsComicDate}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Armath [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-15.<ref name="TEA" />
